title: Reeb and Cane Creek Collaborate on Invert Chassis Kit for the Steezl
content:
Speed metal kings Reeb Cycles joined in with Cane Creek to collaborate on a limited-edition Invert Chassis Kit for its 155 mm travel Steezl. This limited pack will be offered only in October…

Hot damn. This looks phenomenal. Reeb partnered with Cane Creek to offer a limited-edition Invert Chassis Kit, featuring the highly sought-after Invert Enduro fork, custom colored dual finish frame, headset, rear shock, and decal kit, specifically for its Steezl.

The 155mm-travel Steezl is built in-house and features our American-made rockers, hardware, and seat clamp. The Cane Creek Invert Enduro fork brings moto-inspired inverted-fork performance to the platform, with an overbuilt chassis designed to deliver increased traction and smoothness in steep, fast, rough, and high-speed terrain.

Finished with a custom-colored Cane Creek chassis and matching decal kit, this collaboration brings the REEB and Cane Creek platforms together in a truly unique build. This Limited Edition Kit is available October 1-31, and quantities are limited.

Specs:

  • Steezl with Dual Satin/Gloss Lux Nightfall Powdercoat Finish
  • Confirmed delivery of Cane Creek Invert Fork
  • Cane Creek Hellbender 70 Slate Chroma Studio Headset
  • Custom Matching Frame and Fork Decals with Cane Creek Slate accents
    Black Anodized Prosise Metal Works Rockers and Hardware
  • Choice of Cane Creek rear shock (Kitsuma Coil, Kitsuma Air or Tigon)
  • Available as Chassis or choose the custom build option to build out a complete bike

Check it out at Reeb Cycles.
